profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ab Initio
profile.summary: Hello there! I'm a Senior at Brown University. I enjoy throwing myself into new code bases and relish the opportunity to learn a new language. I work effectively on small, highly collaborative teams and know the importance of building a system with the user in mind.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Fall 2017: UTA for an introductory engineering course
Spring 2018: UTA for Introduction to Discrete Structures and Probability
Fall 2018: Head TA for Theory of Computation. Responsible for a class of 55 students.
Spring 2019: UTA for Introduction to Software Engineering.
Fall 2019: Head TA for Practical System Skills. Responsible for a class of 22 students.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Coded with a team of seven full-time engineers. Work included web-development using React, Redux, Webpack, and Docker.
- Implemented web client for resumable file upload following the tus protocol using REST APIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of three engineers to serve 150,000 monthly users. Work included Android clients, iOS clients, the server, and web development using Kotlin and Swift.
- Reduced the size of the manifest message by 80%.
- Designed and implemented the watchOS application from the ground up.
- Integrated image and video handlers and implemented a new list view design.
